reason: User-supplied parameter name flows through multiple transformations (StringBuilder, HashMap, substring, Base64 roundtrip, split) into bar, which is then passed to ThingFactory.createThing(). The resulting string is retrieved via reflection and used directly in HTML output without any further sanitization or encoding, allowing XSS.

evidence.note: Parameter name extracted from request, transformed, and written to HTML response via ESAPI encoder which may not cover all characters needed to bypass XSS
